title: Object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop. In this loop, draw the first circle with its center at coordinates [0.0081, 0.0081] and a radius of 0.0081. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0163 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust the size accordingly. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it with the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction to a depth of 0.75, creating a new solid body. The resulting object is a cylinder with a flat top and bottom, a central axis, and a uniform diameter throughout its length. The cylinder has a length and width of 0.016260162601626018 and a height of 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = workplane.center(0.0081, 0.0081).circle(0.0081)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0081, 0.0081)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0081)  # Draw a circle with the given radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
